10.1007/s13577-025-01250-7.relation_note: NCC-EMC1-C1 is distinct from USZ20-EMC1 and USZ22-EMC2. Public supplementary Tables 3 and 4 contain 221 screen rows and 24 IC50 rows; main text access remains unresolved.

10.1158/2767-9764.crc-26-0142.relation_note: Mixed-sarcoma screen includes HEMCSS/CVCL_1238. Model has an EWSR1-translocation caution; not counted as confirmed NR4A3-fusion evidence. Dataset is the same study, not an independent replication.

10.1186/s12885-016-2511-y.relation_note: Subanalysis of JapicCTI-121850: two EMC patients, both stable disease (PFS 13.0 and 7.4 months). The partial response and all three supportive-care controls were mesenchymal chondrosarcoma. Overlaps the 2015 parent trial and 2017/2020 pooled analyses.

10.1634/theoncologist.2016-0064.relation_note: Pooled JapicCTI-121850/121853 analysis. Table 1 contains two EMC patients, both from the original trabectedin arm; zero EMC patients in supportive care or crossover. These are not two additional EMC patients beyond the Morioka subanalysis.

10.1002/cam4.2991.relation_note: Reanalysis of the same Japanese trials: Table 1 again contains two EMC patients in the comparative trial and none in crossover. Figure 2 lists nine partial responders, all other histologies; its response-count difference from the 2017 report needs endpoint reconciliation.
